new = '''def _row_matrix(rows):
    """Padded int16 matrix of real prefixes; padding never matches a bound."""
    count = len(rows)
    widest = 0
    distinct_wide = 0
    uniques = []
    for _, values in rows:
        if len(values) > widest:
            widest = len(values)
        unique = sorted(set(values))
        uniques.append(unique)
        if len(unique) > distinct_wide:
            distinct_wide = len(unique)
    matrix = np.full((count, widest), -1, dtype=np.int16)
    # Sorted distinct values per row, padded above every legal bound: a row can
    # only match a coordinate interval when it holds a value inside it.
    distinct = np.full((count, max(1, distinct_wide)), SENTINEL, dtype=np.int16)
    lengths = np.zeros(count, dtype=np.int64)
    labels = np.zeros(count, dtype=np.int64)
    for index, ((label, values), unique) in enumerate(zip(rows, uniques)):
        labels[index] = label
        lengths[index] = len(values)
        if len(values):
            matrix[index, :len(values)] = values
            distinct[index, :len(unique)] = unique
    return matrix, distinct, lengths, labels


def _usable_rows(matrix, distinct, lengths, labels, length):
    usable = lengths >= length
    if not usable.any():
        return None
    if usable.all():
        return matrix, distinct, labels
    return matrix[usable], distinct[usable], labels[usable]


def _coverage(sub, distinct, labels, bounds, classes, length):
    """Validation rows holding at least one window inside every interval."""
    rows = sub.shape[0]
    possible = np.ones(rows, dtype=bool)
    for axis in range(length):
        lo, hi = bounds[axis]
        possible &= (np.searchsorted(distinct, hi, side='right') >
                     np.searchsorted(distinct, lo, side='left'))
    chosen = np.nonzero(possible)[0]
    if chosen.size == 0:
        return [0]*classes
    block = sub if chosen.size == rows else sub[chosen]
    picked = labels if chosen.size == rows else labels[chosen]
    window = block.shape[1]-length+1
    lo, hi = bounds[0]
    row_index, offset = np.nonzero((block[:, 0:window] >= lo) & (block[:, 0:window] <= hi))
    for axis in range(1, length):
        if row_index.size == 0:
            break
        lo, hi = bounds[axis]
        values = block[row_index, offset+axis]
        keep = (values >= lo) & (values <= hi)
        row_index = row_index[keep]
        offset = offset[keep]
    if row_index.size == 0:
        return [0]*classes
    hit = np.zeros(block.shape[0], dtype=bool)
    hit[row_index] = True
    return np.bincount(picked[hit], minlength=classes).tolist()


def calibrate(bounds_list, rows, classes):
    """Per-class matching validation-row counts for every interval pattern."""
    empty = [0]*classes
    if not rows:
        return [list(empty) for _ in bounds_list]
    matrix, distinct, lengths, labels = _row_matrix(rows)
    cache = {}
    views = {}
    results = []
    for bounds in bounds_list:
        key = tuple(tuple(pair) for pair in bounds)
        hits = cache.get(key)
        if hits is None:
            length = len(bounds)
            if length not in views:
                views[length] = _usable_rows(matrix, distinct, lengths, labels, length)
            view = views[length]
            if view is None:
                hits = list(empty)
            else:
                hits = _coverage(view[0], view[1], view[2], bounds, classes, length)
            cache[key] = hits
        results.append(hits)
    return results


'''
